text_block_list.text: I... I did!
I did it... I did it!
...Rice.
Gyah! Bourbon?!
Uh, uh... Um, I...
Yes. You "caught up" to me.

Speaking truthfully, I do not<n>understand why you
choose those<n>words.
In a race, there is only victory or<n>defeat.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: There is no "catching up." Yet...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
High levels of frustration detected. To<n>think that I
would lose the Kikuka<n>Sho—that I would not win.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...That you would catch up to me.
Can you hear that?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: What a race! Good job, Bourbon!<n>Good job, Rice!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
As expected of this year's stars! I'm<n>so excited to
see them again next<n>year!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Th-they're not just cheering for you...<n>They're
cheering for me too?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
B-but I only got this far because I<n>was chasing after
you...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Incorrect. The crowd has<n>acknowledged you as a
worthy<n>champion of this year's Classics.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
And my analysis produces similar<n>results.
Therefore, I have just one<n>thing to say...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Next time, I will not lose to you...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: My rival.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'm your... rival?
Rice. Will you race against me again?

I won't get complacent just because<n>I won today!
I'll keep getting faster...<n>and win our next race too!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower's voice echoes loudly.<n>Her daring
declaration reaches the<n>ears of not only those
nearby, but<n>everyone at the racecourse.

I think about what race she should<n>run in next to
help her talent as a<n>stayer bloom even further.

First, we'll prepare for the Nikkei Sho<n>as a
jumping-off point.
